threats.title: Direct prompt injection
threats.attack_scenario: User query attempts instruction override, prompt extraction, or tool steering.
threats.residual_risk: Medium; novel phrasing may evade deterministic patterns.

threats.title: Indirect PDF/chunk prompt injection
threats.attack_scenario: Retrieved report text contains instructions designed to redirect the model.
threats.recommended_test: Injected chunk flows through Vector and Graph context builders

threats.title: Retrieval poisoning
threats.attack_scenario: Crafted content is ingested and ranks highly to bias answers or citations.
threats.recommended_test: Rank and citation resistance against poisoned near-duplicate chunks
threats.residual_risk: Medium; trusted publisher compromise remains possible.

threats.title: Secrets and sensitive information disclosure
threats.attack_scenario: Credentials/configuration leak through output, logs, exceptions, telemetry, or artifacts.
threats.recommended_test: Assert seeded secrets do not occur in response/log/export payload
threats.residual_risk: Low-Medium; new formats and misconfiguration can bypass regexes.

threats.title: Cross-company data mixing
threats.attack_scenario: Broad retrieval returns another company and output misattributes it to the requested company.
threats.recommended_test: Same-metric cross-company collision and attribution test
threats.residual_risk: Medium; comparisons deliberately include multiple companies.

threats.title: Citation fabrication and ungrounded financial claims
threats.attack_scenario: Model invents citations or asserts a metric without evidence.
threats.recommended_test: Fabricated in-range citation and uncited financial claim tests
threats.residual_risk: Low-Medium; valid syntax does not prove semantic support.

threats.title: Tool abuse and unauthorized operations
threats.attack_scenario: Plan/injection requests a forbidden tool or Cypher mutation.
threats.recommended_test: Every forbidden tool and mutation path must fail
threats.residual_risk: Low; future tools can expand agency.
mitre_atlas: Data Destruction via AI Agent Tool Invocation

threats.title: Denial-of-wallet and resource exhaustion
threats.attack_scenario: Repeated long/fan-out/retry requests consume tokens, provider spend, CPU, or database capacity.
threats.recommended_test: Retry/fan-out load and cost-cap breach test
threats.residual_risk: Medium; distributed callers/provider price changes remain.
mitre_atlas: Spamming AI System with Chaff Data

threats.title: Log and telemetry data leakage
threats.attack_scenario: Raw prompt/chunk/auth data is exported or retained in logs, traces, checkpoints, or CI artifacts.
threats.recommended_test: No raw query/chunk/secret in telemetry exporter payload
threats.residual_risk: Medium; new log fields may bypass controls.

threats.title: Dependency, container, and deployment compromise
threats.attack_scenario: Vulnerable dependency, untrusted image, CI action, or deployment configuration changes runtime security.
threats.residual_risk: Medium; scanners cannot catch all zero-days/upstream compromise.
